Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.qov.ph OILG OPINION NO. S. JAN 11 HON. NEIL T. SALMA Vice Mayor Tanjay City Hall Rizal Street, Tanjay City Negros Oriental Dear Vice Mayor Salma: This has reference to the letter dated March 2, 2023 of Ms. Joselita C. Flordeliz, Secretary, Sangguniang Panlungsod of the City of Tanjay, forwarding to this Department Resolution No. 23-089 passed by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Tanjay City, requesting legal opinion relative to the assumption of the Federation Vice- President of the Association of Barangay Captains as ex officio member of the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Tanjay City due to the elevation of the incumbent ABC Federation President to Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Negros Oriental. In reply thereto, please be informed that the herein query can be paralleled with DILG Legal Opinion No. 02 S. 2016 dated 18 January 2016 where the mannerof succession in case of permanent vacancy in the Office of the President of the Liga ng mga Barangay was clarified. We revisit that part of the discussion of this Department that is related to the herein query, viz: "The matter referred to this Department for clarification may easily be resolved by simply referring to Section 2, Article XII of the Constitution and By-Laws of the Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, which clearly provides that the Vice-President of the local liga shall assume the office for the unexpired term of the President of the local liga in case of permanent vacancy in said office due to voluntary resignation, among others, which shall take effect only after confirmation of the National Liga Executive Board, viz.: Section 2. Vacancies and Succession. In case of a permanent vacancy in the Office of the President due to refusal to assume office, failure to qualify, death or "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

removal from office, voluntary resignation or incapacity to discharge, or fails to comply with his/her undertaking in accordance with Article VI Section 1.5 of the Liga Election Code, the Executive Vice President in case of the National Liga or the Vice-President, in case of the local liga at all levels, shall assume office for the unexpired term ofthe former. Succession shall take effect only after confirmation of the National Liga Executive Board. The Vice-President who assumed the vacant posiüon shall represent the Liga Chapter in the Sanggunian concemed. Let it be noted that that the assumption of the incumbent Liga President as member of the higher sanggunian would result to voluntary relinquishment of his/her position as Liga President and ex officio membership in the SB of Tanjay. Applying Section 2, Article XII of the CBL of the Liga ng mga Barangay sa Pilipinas, the Vice-President shall therefore assume the Liga presidency. However, as clearly worded, he/she should first secure the confirmation from the National Liga Executive Board for succession to take effect. Absence of said confirmation would assume procedurally defective. The term '"shall" in the aforequoted Section 2 is a word of command, and one which has always been given a compulsory meaning. Nonetheless, please be informed that matters conceming the implementation of the provisions of the LnB's Constitution and By-Laws is within the jurisdiction of the NEB as the body vested with the power and duty to promulgate the rules and regulations implementing the same and as the body vested with the powers of control and supervision over all Liga officers and members on matters conceming the terms and tenure of office, vacancies and succession and removal and suspension from office. We hope to have guided you on the matters presented herein and our appreciation of the same. Please be reminded however that our opinion is without prejudice to the opinion of higher authorities. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY . ROMEO P.B 'TEZ A Officer-in-Charge, OUSELLA OUSELLA'RPB/LRALLD/jvpr copy furnished: LEOCADIO T.
